description: Development of proposed priority infrastructure for minibus-taxis and peak hour traffic count data is a data set deposited in University of Pretoria by its authors John Mwenda. The paratransit industry in South Africa which mainly includes the minibus-taxis is growing at a fast pace. Thus, it has become the largest mobility supplier to the urban public. Coverage: national (ZA); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 4757040 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
